comments.story_title: The Old Are Eating the Young
comments.why_zh: Rosling 表明全球出生率已接近更替水平，人口正在趋于稳定
comments.quote_zh: 如果你还没看过他的视频，我强烈推荐。
comments.text_zh: 这个视频似乎很相关：[VIDEO] 按照 Hans Rosling 的说法，我们已经达到了“peak child”，也就是说全球平均每名女性几乎只生2个孩子。这意味着，由于全球儿童数量多于成年人，人口还会继续增长几年，但之后会稳定在约110亿的水平。只要我们保持在这个“peak child”的数字上，就不会再继续增长。如果你还没看过他的视频，我强烈推荐。
comments.text: This video seems relevant: [VIDEO] According to Hans Rosling we've reached "peak child", meaning we're almost at 2 children per woman globally. This means population will continue to grow for a few years as globally there are more children than adults but will stabilize after that around the ~11 billion mark. And as long as we stay at that "peak child" number we won't go any further. I really recommend his videos if you haven't seen them.

comments.author: jdietrich
comments.story_title: India's Indira canteen: The best meal you can buy for 13 cents
comments.why_zh: 通过儿童存活率和经济发展来解释出生率下降
comments.quote_zh: 我强烈推荐已故的 Hans Rosling 的这场讲座
comments.text_zh: 直到现代之前，全球出生率一直相当稳定，大约是每名女性生六个孩子。我们在过去一个世纪经历的人口增长，主要与儿童存活率有关。1900年以前，印度的儿童死亡率超过50%。如果你需要孩子在你年老时照顾你，又预计大多数孩子会夭折，那你很可能就会生很多孩子。当儿童存活率提高后，观念也变了。父母不再想要三四个孩子去家庭农场干活，而是想要一两个孩子成为医生或工程师。经济发展和可靠避孕手段的普及，让这种愿望变得可行。如果你对这个话题感兴趣，我强烈推荐已故的 Hans Rosling 的这场讲座：[VIDEO]
comments.text: Until the modern era, the global birth rate was fairly constant at about six per woman. The population growth we've experienced over the last century is mostly to do with child survival. Before 1900, the child mortality rate in India was over 50%. If you need children to care for you in old age and expect most of your children to die, you're likely to have a lot of them. When child survival improved, attitudes changed. Parents no longer want three or four children to work on the family farm, they want one or two children to become doctors or engineers. Economic development and the availability of reliable contraception have made that aspiration practical. If you're interested in the topic, I can highly recommend this lecture by the late Hans Rosling: [VIDEO]

comments.why_zh: 说明人口将趋于稳定，而人们对世界统计数据存在错误认知
comments.text_zh: 因为世界并不存在人口过剩。人们从古代起就在谈论人口过剩。[链接] 目前，几乎全世界的生活水平都在提高，而据预测，人口将达到约 110 亿并趋于稳定。我强烈推荐“DON'T PANIC — Hans Rosling showing the facts about population”[视频] 他视频里另一点也很有意思：人们往往对世界形势有严重的错误认知。比如，被问到某些统计数据时，他们的回答比随机猜测还差。而且你受教育程度越高，可能被误导得越深。
comments.text: Because there is no world overpopulation. People talk about overpopulation since ancient times. [LINK] Currently standard of living are growing almost all over the world and human population is predicted to pick and stabilize at around 11 billion. I really recommend "DON'T PANIC — Hans Rosling showing the facts about population" [VIDEO] What's also interesting in his video is the fact that people tend to be very misinformed about state of the world affairs. E.g. when asked questions about certain statistics, they do worse than random. And the better educated you are the more misinformed you may be.

comments.author: Isinlor
comments.story_title: World Scientists’ Warning of a Climate Emergency
comments.why_zh: 展示了孟加拉国计划生育的实践情况
comments.quote_zh: 他展示了在孟加拉国等国家，计划生育在实践中是什么样子
comments.text_zh: 这里的问题主要出在极端贫困的国家，也就是平均生育率达到3及以上的国家。生育率最高国家的女性往往无法掌控自己何时怀孕。生6个甚至更多孩子，很少是有意识家庭规划的结果，而是缺乏教育、缺乏避孕手段、婚姻内强迫性行为等造成的结果。有时生很多孩子是一种保险策略，以防有些孩子活不到能劳动的年龄。我们确实应该解决这种不受控制的人口增长背后的根本问题。人们应当能够选择何时要孩子、想要几个孩子，应当接受如何供养孩子的教育，当然也不该担心自己的一部分子女会夭折。这跟中国那样惩罚生育完全不是一回事。我强烈推荐《DON'T PANIC — Hans Rosling showing the facts about population》。他展示了孟加拉国等国家计划生育在实践中是什么样子，让西方人能够想象我们在谈论什么：[VIDEO] 应对全球变暖的进展很不顺利，我们确实应该为此恐慌，但人类在控制人口增长方面正取得巨大进步。你生3个孩子真的没什么问题。西方人口无论如何都会下降，因为西方国家的生育率大多低于2。只是，请支持政治和系统性的变革
comments.text: The issue here is mostly with the countries in extreme poverty. Countries with average fertility rate of 3 and higher. Women in countries with the highest fertility index often do not control when they get pregnant. Having 6 and more children is rarely effect of conscious family planning. It's effect of lack of education, lack of access to contraception, forced sex in marriage etc. Sometimes having many children is an insurance policy in case some children will die before they reach productive age. We really should be addressing this type of issues underlying uncontrolled population growth. People should be able to choose when they want to have children, how many children they want, they should be educated on how to provide for their children, and certainly people should not be afraid that some part of their offspring will die. It has nothing to do with penalizing having children like they did in China. I really recommend, "DON'T PANIC — Hans Rosling showing the facts about population". He shows how family planning looks like in practice in countries like Bangladesh, so that westerners can imagine what are we talking about: [VIDEO] Dealing with global warming is going bad and we should panic about that, but humanity is making great progress on controlling population growth. There is really no issue with you having 3 children. Western population will be declining anyway as fertility rate in western countries is mostly below 2. Just please, support political, systematical chang

comments.why_zh: 安抚人们，对人口的担忧被夸大了
comments.quote_zh: 那样的话就不用担心了
comments.text_zh: 那样的话就不用担心了：[VIDEO] 另外还要考虑到，世界的承载能力并不是固定的，而是取决于我们的技术有多好（可能存在一个理论上的上限）。而技术是由那些研究和发明更好技术的人推动进步的，对吧？所以人越多，技术就越好——而技术越好，又能让更多人去研究更好的技术。最大的错误，也是所有马尔萨斯主义者犯过的错误，就是忘了人类平均而言是净生产者，而不是净消费者。
comments.text: In that case don't worry: [VIDEO] Also consider that the carrying capacity of the world isn't fixed, but depends on how good our technology is (with a potential theoretical upper limit). Well tech is improved by people working on and inventing better technology, right? So you get better technology with more people - and with that you can have more people working on better technology. The biggest mistake, and the one all Malthusians made, is to forget that humans are, on average, net produces not net consumers.

comments.why_zh: 被引用来证明人口增长是一个已经解决的问题
comments.quote_zh: 人口增长是一个已经解决的问题。
comments.text_zh: 联合国预测，全球人口将在2100年前达到约110亿的绝对峰值。一些预测甚至更保守，认为到2050年就会达到90亿的峰值。全球出生率已经见顶，目前总体呈下降趋势，大多数发达国家的生育率都远低于更替水平。我们下个世纪将看到的人口增长，大多只是因为更多人活得更久。中国的生育率远低于更替水平，为每名女性1.57个孩子。印度则仅略高于更替水平，为2.4。如今印度的生育率低于美国1970年的生育率。全球生育率在50年里减半。即使在撒哈拉以南非洲最贫穷的国家，生育率也在下降。卢旺达的生育率从1980年的8.4降至如今的3.8，降幅超过一半。据我所知，尼日尔是地球上生育率持续居高不下的国家。人口增长是一个已经解决的问题。[VIDEO]
comments.text: The UN forecast that the global population will reach an absolute maximum of about 11 billion by 2100. Some forecasts are even more conservative, suggesting a peak of 9 billion by 2050. The global birth rate has peaked and is now in overall decline, with most of the developed world being well below the replacement rate. Most of the population growth we'll see over the next century is simply due to more people living longer lives. The fertility rate in China is massively below replacement at 1.57 births per woman. India is barely above replacement at 2.4. The fertility rate in India today is lower than the fertility rate was in the US in 1970. The global fertility rate has halved in 50 years. Even in the poorest countries in sub-Saharan Africa, the fertility rate is declining. The fertility rate in Rwanda has more than halved from 8.4 in 1980 to 3.8 today. As far as I can ascertain, Niger is the country on earth with a persistently high fertility rate. Population growth is a solved problem. [VIDEO]
